surfaces.primary_action: Add Maanta to my phone (falls back to manual Android/iOS instructions)
surfaces.notes: Added 2026-08-19 (drift D94). The install landing, linked from SiteFooter.tsx and three marketing CTAs. Shipped, but the install funnel is UNPROVEN rather than working: the primary CTA renders only when `beforeinstallprompt` has fired and been captured, and whether it ever fires in production is a device question nothing in CI observes (drift D93). public/sw.js still registers only `push` and `notificationclick` with no `fetch` handler (drift D92 closed on copy; the capability question is drift D95, founder-owned), and Chrome's installability criteria have historically required one. Repo-side icon work is done: the manifest declares `any` and `maskable` at SVG plus raster 192/512, and appleWebApp metadata is set. Do not read the primary action as evidence that anyone has installed the app.

surfaces.primary_action: Route the signed-in user to their role's home (no rendered action)
surfaces.notes: Added 2026-08-19 (drift D94). The web manifest `start_url` (src/app/manifest.ts) and the post-login fallback for every role, so it is the FIRST screen an installed user sees and the one they land on with no route back if it breaks. It has no UI of its own — a broken bootstrap presents as a blank or stuck screen, not an error. Cross-references: drift D93 (the install funnel it terminates is unproven on devices) and drift D92/D95 (no service-worker fetch handler, so nothing here works without a network).
